'''2013 Worlds Day 2 Greg Shaw LS You Can Either Profit By This...''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Greg Shaw]] at [[2013 World Championship]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed|EJP-L-youcaneitherprofitbythis.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
